entities.summary: Henry Domercant is an American-born naturalized Bosnian professional basketball coach and former player currently working as an assistant coach for the Chicago Bulls of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for Eastern Illinois, and was an All-EuroLeague Second Team selection in 2012.
